evidence: Twelve complete preregistered CI shards, six per Python version. Each row compares routes within one runner; no time samples, medians or latency scores pooled across runners/Python.
memory_scope: Python tracemalloc peak of build in a separate child; not RSS or cold-receiver peak.
certificate_bytes_scope: Certificate envelope; required independent source/request bytes recorded separately.
validation: ZIP SHA-256 matches GitHub artifact digest; every run manifest checked; every SUMMARY recalculated from raw records; CI normal/-O replay results agree; current code hashes and accepted-file preservation checked.

interrupted_local_run.reason: Execution session no longer available after turn interruption; observed from retained ledger. No retry or completion inferred.
